title: Dashboard/folder UID collisions must be disambiguated by kind, not UID alone
answers: Browse dashboards crashes with RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded
Expanding a folder freezes the browse page
Unselecting a dashboard hangs the tab
Why does a Git Sync dashboard break the folder tree?
body: Symptom: expanding a folder in the dashboard browser crashes with 'RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded', or a fresh tab/unselect freezes, when a dashboard's UID equals its parent folder's UID (Git Sync produces this). Root cause: unified storage namespaces UIDs per kind, but public/app/features/browse-dashboards/state/utils.ts:findItem matched items by uid only, and the ancestor-walk in reducers.ts:setItemSelectionState (and the recursive tree builder in state/hooks.ts:createFlatTree) treated every item as a folder, so a same-UID dashboard resolved as its own parent/child forever. Fix pattern: require callers to pass the item kind alongside uid wherever items from different kinds can share a UID (findItem now takes a DashboardViewItemKind param), and gate any 'treat item as a folder with children' branch on `item.kind === 'folder'` before recursing or looking up children/ancestors. Constraints: applies to any browse-dashboards tree/selection code reading childrenByParentUID or walking parentUID chains; does not apply to code that already scopes lookups to a single kind's collection.
applies: browse-dashboards tree traversal, selection, and any code resolving a folder/dashboard by UID when unified-storage kind-namespaced UIDs can collide

search: Dashboard/folder UID collisions (Git Sync can produce same UID for a dashboard and its parent folder) must be disambiguated by kind, because unified storage namespaces UIDs per kind. The ancestor-walk in public/app/features/browse-dashboards/state/utils.ts:findItem, reducers.ts:setItemSelectionState, and state/hooks.ts:createFlatTree must require the item kind (DashboardViewItemKind param) alongside uid, and gate any 'treat item as a folder with children' branch on `item.kind === 'folder'` before recursing. Without kind checking, same-UID dashboard resolves as its own parent/child, causing infinite recursion ('RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded') or freezes during unselect. Applies to browse-dashboards tree traversal, selection, and any code resolving items by uid when walking childrenByParentUID or parentUID chains; does not apply where code already scopes lookups to a single kind's collection.
